judgments.rationale: The experiment evidence marks run-20260718T060515Z-e34e0f23 as a valid non-baseline run with Accuracy 0.6249490419894007 and improvement 0.05625764370158992; together these values support the stated baseline Accuracy of 0.5686913982878108.
The packet supports Accuracy 0.6249490419894007, but it does not provide or verify any task target score of 0.905, so the full claim is not established by the supplied evidence.

The bounded literature packet includes end-to-end research-agent systems (for example EvoScientist and Autonomous Research Loops) and separate evidence-grounding or claim-verification systems (for example RefLens, ECE, and CliVER).

Within the provided reviewed set, the records describe end-to-end research agents, verification systems, and search strategies, but none establishes a controlled same-backbone ablation showing that adding a claim-level evidence gate reduces unsupported claims versus the same backbone without that gate.
